# The Future of Carpet Basics — fundamentals self-quiz (Advanced, public edition)
# Run: python3 quiz.py
qa = [
    ("What is Pad?", "the cushion beneath"),
    ("What is Vacuum?", "weekly vacuuming is the real maintenance"),
    ("State one governing principle of carpet basics.", "Vacuum weekly; grit is what wears carpet out."),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    print(f"A{i}: {a}")
    score += 1
print(f"Quiz complete: reviewed {score} of {len(qa)} key points.")
